findings.title: Strict JSON validation loses transport context
findings.expected: Valid JSON arrays and aware RFC3339 timestamps must round-trip under the strict contract.
findings.observed: Cmd-0014 actually reports 18 setup errors rejecting valid arrays/dates, one distinct failed security case and seven passed cases; its process exits 1.
findings.rootCause: An inherited model-before validator materializes the entire JSON model as a Python dictionary before strict tuple/datetime handling. Restrict boolean prevalidation to the permission fields.

findings.title: SQL text interprets inline JSON colons as bindings
findings.expected: The actual corruption and legacy fixtures must reach PostgreSQL with the intended JSON bytes.
findings.observed: Cmd-0023 preserves two StatementError failures demanding bind parameter true before those fixtures execute; 27 other cases pass and owned cleanup is complete.
findings.rootCause: Inline JSON literals inside SQLAlchemy text contain colon-prefixed tokens that its lexical binder treats as parameters. Bind the JSON data through CAST(:body AS JSONB), without changing either substantive corruption/legacy assertion.
findings.resolution: Actual complete causal local suites, clean/adverse controls and fresh real source capture pass; original failures remain. No whole-Gate or independent verdict is inferred.

findings.title: Public storage identity misclassified as bearer secret
findings.expected: Public source package names remain valid while actual HMAC/provider/storage/database secrets and their declared forms remain refused.
findings.observed: Cmd-0040: new explicit credential-free runtime classifier case fails AUTHORIZATION_MATERIAL_REFUSED; 172 other API cases pass. Cmd-0038 also retains the first live clean-capture control failure after real provider/sandbox task and quality PASS; its original upstream code was not recorded, so that live causal link requires retest.
findings.rootCause: The runtime put the MinIO public account/access identity in the same exact-value set as bearer keys and passwords. The committed public identity occurs in legitimate quality package/report names, so the actual owning-image classifier refuses those bytes with AUTHORIZATION_MATERIAL_REFUSED. Field masking/type alone is not a definition of a secret. No value is globally allowlisted and actual secret scanning or password protection may not be weakened.
findings.resolution: Actual complete causal local suites, clean/adverse controls and fresh real source capture pass; original failures remain. No whole-Gate or independent verdict is inferred.

findings.title: Source query fetches unneeded private columns before safe projection
findings.expected: The real SQL projection reads only consumed bounded observable source facts.
findings.observed: The actual owning PostgreSQL regression detects an unneeded private task_runs column in the executed SELECT. This is over-fetch into memory, not evidence of private content persisted/exported.
findings.rootCause: Selecting ORM entities loaded whole source records before projecting the closed document. Final serialization excluded private text, but the SQL read still fetched unneeded task results, agent output and event payloads. Cardinality alone did not bound source JSON/text. Select only consumed columns with raiseload, extract exact workspace/permission scalars and bound required command arguments in SQL before loading.
findings.resolution: Actual complete causal local suites, clean/adverse controls and fresh real source capture pass; original failures remain. No whole-Gate or independent verdict is inferred.

findings.title: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: strict engineering-memory text scan
findings.observed: Cmd-0056 actually returns LESSONS_INVALID on the new LSN-0138 title. Cmd-0059 then refuses nine actual changed paths containing stale derived copies or adjacent descriptive labels. The neutral receipt preserves the original title identity, bytes/digest and actual classifier refusal without exporting rejected text. Correct only those labels and regenerate canonical derived artifacts; no scanner or exemption changes.
findings.requiredCorrection: G6-INT-008: Cmd-0056 rejects a new memory title under unchanged strict detection. The guarded actual-delta principle also applies to memory text, not only source. Retain the failure and neutral original digest, reword only the label, keep both scanners unchanged and require actual memory/delta/checkpoint acceptance.
findings.resolution: Only descriptive labels and their canonical derived copies changed. Both unchanged strict boundaries and actual serialized checkpoint acceptance pass; original red observations and recurrence severity/counter remain.

findings.title: Local summary overwrites required continuation structure
findings.observed: Cmd-0081 actually rejects preparatory finalization with all14 missing HANDOFF headings and an unpopulated NEXT structure; no runtime commit or final seal was issued.
findings.rootCause: The local assembler replaced the structured handoff with a prose summary and emitted NEXT without its mandatory subsection. Semantically related prose does not satisfy the canonical artifact structure. Render every owning-validator heading in order with substantive content; reject missing/empty sections and retain the next-action heading before writing. Never relax the validator.
findings.resolution: Canonical headings are consumed from their owning validator and every section requires substantive content. Actual output, omission/empty mutations and current checkpoint acceptance pass; no required heading or check was removed.
